catalyst.title: Securitize brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana, with NYSE trading in the works
catalyst.summary: Tokenized shares in the mega-caps will first trade on Securitize's Solana-based platform, with further plans to expand them to NYSE and OKXICE digital venues, the firm said.

catalyst.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
catalyst.summary: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.
